skills.name: yt_brain_search
skills.description: Search the user's personal YouTube knowledge brain for indexed video notes, takeaways, concepts, and transcripts from watched videos.

query.description: Search keyword or concept to search within watched YouTube video notes

limit.description: Maximum number of note results to return (default: 5)

skills.name: yt_brain_get
skills.description: Retrieve full note content, key takeaways, and metadata for a specific watched YouTube video by video_id or note path.

path.description: Relative or absolute path to the video markdown note

skills.name: yt_brain_topics
skills.description: List all indexed topics, categories, and video counts in the user's personal YouTube knowledge brain.

skills.name: yt_brain_status
skills.description: Check the operational status of the YouTube knowledge brain (total indexed videos, available topics, worker connection, and latest video).
